== Notes ==
* This attack exactly requires 80 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 3 strikes and 5 units.
* The damage dealt to adjacent targets does not trigger on-hit effects.
* The damage to adjacent targets is [[Armor-ignoring damage|armor-ignoring]] [[physical damage]]: it benefits from [[Winnowing]] and triggers [[Mark of Pain]] and [[Barbs]].
* Damages target foe and foes ''adjacent to target foe''.
{{bug|Contrary to the descriptions, damage is dealt to an additional {{gr|2|3}} foes.}}

==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use this skill whenever it is charged, but with lower priority than skills with greater/additional effect(s).
